newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Cotati-Rohnert Park SD, Calif..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Cotati-Rohnert Park SD, Calif..

text.p: NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN, pursuant to California Government Code Section 53692, that the Board of Supervisors of the County of Sonoma, State of California, intends to sell not to exceed $9,000,000 principal amount of Cotati-Rohnert Park Unified School District Sonoma County, California, General Obligation Bonds, Capital Appreciation Series F Bonds, at public sale. Bids will be received on and (without further advertising) so long as a proposal has not been theretofore accepted or notice to the contrary is given, on each succeeding Thursday at 10:00 a.m., at Jones Hall Hill & White, A Professional Law Corporation, Four Embarcadero Center, 19th Floor, San Francisco, California, 94111, (415) 391-5780, and the sale will be awarded by the Treasurer-Tax Collector of the County of Sonoma pursuant to the order of the Board of Supervisors of Sonoma County within six (6) hours after the time prescribed for receipt of bids. Further information, including copies of the preliminary Official Statement, Official Notice of Sale and form of Bid Proposal, may be obtained from Kelling,
Northcross & Nobriga, Inc., at 1333 Broadway, Suite 1000, Oakland, California, 94612, (510) 839-8200.
